title: MIST: Multimodal Survival Prediction with Genomic-Guided Histology Attention
abstract: arXiv:2609.21811v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Multimodal survival models can combine complementary prognostic information from whole-slide images and genomic profiles, but effective fusion remains challenging amid external cohort shift and computational complexity. To address these challenges, we propose MIST, multimodal survival prediction with genomic-guided histology attention. MIST represents genomic features as tokens and allows them to query compact foundation-model-derived histology context tokens before survival prediction. This design enriches molecular information with histology context rather than merging separately encoded modalities only at the final stage. Training combines discrete-time survival prediction with genomic feature masking, WSI dropout, and paired WSI-genomics contrastive alignment. Across four external evaluations in colon, renal, lung, and glioblastoma cohorts, MIST improves external C-index over standard fusion baselines in the primary comparisons. Thes

translated_title: MIST：基于基因组引导的组织学注意力的多模态生存预测
translated_abstract: 多模态生存模型可以结合来自全切片图像（WSI）和基因组图谱的互补预后信息，但在面临外部队列偏移和计算复杂性的情况下，有效融合仍然具有挑战性。为了解决这些问题，我们提出了MIST，一种基于基因组引导的组织学注意力的多模态生存预测方法。MIST将基因组特征表示为token，并允许它们在生存预测之前查询由基础模型导出的紧凑组织学上下文token。这种设计利用组织学上下文来丰富分子信息，而不是仅在最后阶段才合并分别编码的模态。训练过程将离散时间生存预测与基因组特征掩码、WSI dropout以及配对的WSI-基因组对比对齐相结合。在结肠癌、肾癌、肺癌和胶质母细胞瘤队列的四项外部评估中，MIST在主要比较中将外部C-index提升超过标准融合基线。
tldr: 提出MIST方法，让基因组特征token查询基础模型导出的紧凑组织学上下文token以实现早期深度融合，并结合基因组掩码、WSI dropout和对比对齐等训练策略，在结肠癌、肾癌、肺癌和胶质母细胞瘤四个外部队列上提升了生存预测性能。
en_tdlr: MIST enables genomic feature tokens to query compact foundation-model-derived histology context tokens for early deep fusion, combined with genomic masking, WSI dropout, and contrastive alignment, improving external survival prediction performance across colon, renal, lung, and glioblastoma cohorts.
